name: geometry-tactical-advanced-coop-local
description: Advanced school-safe local tactical geometry game with two complex rooms, 120 Hz simulation, coordinated A* enemy squads, six weapon profiles and drops, strict three-student controls, three-strike trigonometry checkpoints and automatic local JSON/CSV results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-professional-v50.js && node scripts/prepare-advanced-v51.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v51/main.js && node --check school-game/v51/preload.js && node --check school-game/v51/game.js && node scripts/advanced-coop-v51-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
